title: Rigatoni Amatriciana
subtitle: A Roman tomato and guanciale pasta with pecorino
excerpt: Short ridged pasta in a punchy sauce of guanciale, tomatoes, chilli, and sharp pecorino. A weeknight staple once you know the rhythm.
sourceNotes: Roman and Lazio tradition; guanciale and pecorino are the non-negotiable pair.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: The sauce keeps in the fridge for two days. Cook the pasta fresh and combine just before serving.

content.text: Amatriciana is built on guanciale, tomatoes, chilli, and pecorino. The fat from the guanciale carries the whole sauce. Keep the heat moderate so the meat renders without crisping to a hard chew.
Set a large pan of water to boil. Salt it generously once it reaches a rolling boil.

Put the guanciale in a cold frying pan. Place over a medium heat and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until the fat has rendered and the meat is lightly golden. Remove the guanciale with a slotted spoon and set aside.
Add the chilli flakes to the fat in the pan. Cook for 30 seconds. Pour in the white wine if using and let it bubble for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes. Stir and simmer over a low heat for 15 minutes until the sauce thickens. Return the guanciale to the pan.
Cook the rigatoni in the boiling water until 2 minutes short of the packet time. Reserve a mug of pasta water before draining.
Tip the drained pasta into the sauce. Toss over a medium heat for 2 minutes, adding a splash of pasta water to loosen if needed.
Remove from the heat. Stir in half the pecorino and the black pepper. Serve in bowls with the remaining pecorino on top.

items.symptom: The sauce is thin and watery.
items.cause: The tomatoes had too much liquid and the simmer was too short.
items.fix: Keep the lid off and simmer for a further 5 minutes until the sauce coats a spoon.

items.symptom: The guanciale is hard and chewy.
items.cause: The heat was too high and the fat did not render before the meat crisped.
items.fix: Start the guanciale in a cold pan over a moderate heat to coax the fat out slowly.

items.cause: Not enough pasta water was added when tossing.
items.fix: Add the reserved pasta water a tablespoon at a time while tossing until the sauce coats the pasta loosely.
